Worker ASE structure inspection accepts an explicit zero-based frame and bounds preview to 20000 atoms; actual registered ASE parser determines format support. RunDetail currently exposes preview only for xyz/traj file names; do not claim all ASE formats have a frontend entry.
No whole-trajectory animation, streaming index, OVITO pipeline or automatic scientific analysis is inferred from a visual preview.
OVITO official import and pipeline manuals are design references for a future integration; Studio does not ship those API capabilities.
